description: Manages and provides access to the hierarchical structure of organizations, departments, and reporting lines within the system.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current and active organizational hierarchy. This endpoint provides the most up-to-date structure of the organization.
example_uses: Show me the current organizational structure.
Can I get the latest company hierarchy?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the most current and active organizational hierarchy for display, navigation, or general information purposes.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyLegacy
endpoints.description: Retrieves a legacy or historical version of the organizational hierarchy. This might be used for compatibility with older systems, historical reporting, or specific archival needs.
example_uses: I need the historical organizational tree for reporting.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you specifically need to access an older, deprecated, or historical version of the organizational hierarchy, typically for backward compatibility, historical data analysis, or specific reporting requirements that rely on past structures.
